profile.headline: Software Engineer & Product Owner | Building Secure AI Platforms for Cross Domain Scenarios | Active TS/SCI

positions.title: Research Application Engineer
positions.description:
Collaborated with NASA and the USACE to develop a scientific visualization platform to render high fidelity real time geospatial data from LiDAR and Photogrammetry.
Developed two proposed models to implement an Autoregressive and Partially Observable Markov Decision Chain for applications in computer vision and human computer interaction.
